description: This file defines shell functions for comparing git diffs with various heuristics and normalization steps, likely used in testing or validation contexts within a version control environment.

methods.name: compare_diff_raw
methods.description: Compares two diff files after sanitizing them by removing score numbers, used for structure-based diff comparison.

methods.name: compare_diff_raw_z
methods.description: Compares two diff files with additional transformations, including line-ending normalization, for more robust diff comparison.

methods.name: compare_diff_patch
methods.description: Compares two patch files after removing non-essential metadata like similarity indexes and index lines.
